title: Viva Insights Watch
blurb: A running record of changes Microsoft has published to the Microsoft Learn pages behind Microsoft Viva Insights — including how metrics are defined and computed in person queries (the metric reference, metric rules, person query and query results), the advanced (analyst) experience, org and team insights, the Copilot Dashboard and Copilot analytics reports, setup and roles, and the privacy model that governs what analysts and managers can see.

docs.title: Advanced insights metric reference (metric definitions)
docs.why: THE definitions of how every advanced-insights metric is computed. A change here changes what a metric means in a person query — the exact silent-edit risk. Catches body changes even when the published date does not move.

docs.title: Metric rules (how metrics are calculated in queries)
docs.why: How metrics are filtered and calculated when a query runs — signal-hour rules, exclusions, and thresholds that alter person-query metric values.

docs.title: Person query
docs.why: The person query surface itself — how person-level metrics are selected and produced. Changes here change what person queries return.

docs.title: Query results (metric output)
docs.why: How metrics appear in query output — column meanings and result-level metric handling that downstream reports parse.

docs.title: Copilot query
docs.why: Copilot-specific query type and its metrics — the Copilot adoption/impact signal at query level.

docs.title: Metric definitions (end-user)
docs.why: End-user-facing metric definitions — a plainer restatement that should stay consistent with the analyst reference.

docs.title: Introduction to Viva Insights advanced insights
docs.why: The core analyst-experience page. Scope and capability changes here shape every advanced-insights report.

docs.title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard (Viva Insights)
docs.why: THE Copilot adoption/impact dashboard surface in Viva Insights. Metric and capability changes here drive Copilot ROI reporting.

docs.title: Copilot analytics reports in Viva Insights
docs.why: The Copilot-specific analytics reports available to analysts — additions and changes affect what Copilot signal can be measured.

docs.title: Publish advanced insights (Power BI templates)
docs.why: How analysts publish and share advanced-insights Power BI reports — the delivery mechanism for the templates the Hub builds on.

docs.title: Viva Insights advanced insights privacy
docs.why: The privacy and de-identification model that governs what analysts can see — minimum group size, exclusions, and data handling.

docs.title: Assign user roles in advanced insights
docs.why: Who can act as analyst, admin, or limited analyst — the access-control surface for the whole product.

docs.title: Advanced insights environment requirements
docs.why: Prerequisites and environment setup for advanced insights — gating changes affect who can deploy it.

docs.title: Supported environments for advanced insights
docs.why: Which tenant/region configurations are supported — availability changes surface here.

docs.title: Team insights (manager experience)
docs.why: The manager-facing team insights surface — what people leaders can see about their teams.

docs.title: Privacy guide for admins (personal insights)
docs.why: Admin-side privacy controls for the personal insights experience — opt-out and data-handling policy.

docs.title: Viva feature access management
docs.why: Controls which Viva features (including Insights) users can access — the enablement gate across the Viva suite.

docs.title: Introduction to Microsoft Viva Insights
docs.why: Top-level product framing for Viva Insights — naming and positioning changes surface here first.
